basic_details.job_title: UT of DNH & DD Disaster Project Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (UT of DNH & DD) has notified 1 vacancy for the Disaster Project Officer post on a contract basis under advertisement number COL/DIU/DISASTER/2026-27/1485. Eligible Indian Citizens candidates can apply for this purely on Short Term Contract engagement with a pay of Rs. 35,000. how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official websites: https://ddd.gov.in, https://dnh.gov.in, or https://diu.gov.in.
Fill up the details in CAPITAL LETTERS, including name of candidate, present address, e-mail, mobile no., date of birth, educational qualification, and experience.
Paste a recent self-attested passport size photograph on the application form.
Enclose self-attested copies of education qualifications and experience.

Submit the filled application in person or by Speed post/Courier to the S.D.M-cum-Dy. Collector, Disaster Management Cell, Seva Bhavan, Collectorate, Fort Road, Diu-362520 on or before 21/10/2026 up to 5:00 pm.
important_instructions: Person already in service with Government or Other Organization should obtain "No Objection Certificate" from concerned authority and enclose it with application. Person who has been previously terminated from any Govt. organization shall not be considered. The selected candidate will not have any right or claim for regularization against regular or permanent vacancy in future, and shall not be granted age relaxation for future direct recruitment. No interview call letters will be sent to eligible candidate by post, and no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Shortlisted candidates and subsequent Interview notice will be published on the official websites.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The administration has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Disaster Project Officer post under the Disaster Management Cell, Collectorate, Diu.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational and experience requirements to be eligible for the Disaster Project Officer recruitment. Essential Qualification: Master Degree in Disaster Management/ Social Work/Town Planning/Social Science/ other relevant field from a recognized Board/University with 3 years of work experience in a related field. Desirable Qualification: Preference will be given to candidates possessing higher qualification in the same field, and basic computer knowledge. Age Limit: 40 years. The last date of receipt of application shall be the date for determination of age limit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UT of DNH & DD Disaster Project Officer
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the official websites: https://ddd.gov.in, https://dnh.gov.in, or https://diu.gov.in. Fill up the details in CAPITAL LETTERS, including name of candidate, present address, e-mail, mobile no., date of birth, educational qualification, and experience. Paste a recent self-attested passport size photograph on the application form. Enclose self-attested copies of education qualifications and experience. Submit the filled application in person or by Speed post/Courier to the S.D.M-cum-Dy. Collector, Disaster Management Cell, Seva Bhavan, Collectorate, Fort Road, Diu-362520 on or before 21/10/2026 up to 5:00 pm.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Person already in service with Government or Other Organization should obtain "No Objection Certificate" from concerned authority and enclose it with application. Person who has been previously terminated from any Govt. organization shall not be considered. The selected candidate will not have any right or claim for regularization against regular or permanent vacancy in future, and shall not be granted age relaxation for future direct recruitment. No interview call letters will be sent to eligible candidate by post, and no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Shortlisted candidates and subsequent Interview notice will be published on the official websites.

faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly consolidated pay of Rs. 35,000/-.
